\begin{tikzpicture}[
    lens/.style={draw, ellipse, minimum width=1cm, minimum height=3cm, fill=blue!10},
    sensor/.style={draw, rectangle, minimum width=0.2cm, minimum height=2.5cm, fill=gray!30},
    ray/.style={color=red, thick, ->},
    label/.style={font=\small\bfseries\sffamily},
    node distance=0cm
]

    % Coordinates
    \coordinate (L) at (0,0);      
    \coordinate (S) at (4,0);      

    % 1. The Subject Image (sitting.png) 
    % We set the height to 2cm; the node will resize to fit.
    \node (subject) at (-6,0) {\includegraphics[height=2cm]{images/sitting.png}};
    %\node (subject) at (-6,0) {eagle};
    
    \node[label, above=1.1cm] at (-6,0) {SUBJECT};

    % 2. The Lens with Label ON TOP
    \node[lens] (mylens) at (L) {};
    \node[label, above=1.6cm of L] {LENS}; 
    \filldraw[black] (L) circle (2pt);

    % 3. The Sensor with Label ON TOP
    \node[sensor] (mysensor) at (S) {};
    \node[label, above=1.4cm of S] {SENSOR}; 

    % --- Rays and Lines ---
    % Adjusted rays to originate from the top, middle, and bottom of the image node
    \draw[ray] (subject.north east) -- (mylens.150) -- (S);
    \draw[ray] (subject.east) -- (mylens.180) -- (S);
    \draw[ray] (subject.south east) -- (mylens.210) -- (S);

    % Focal Length measurement
    \draw[<->, thick] (0, -2.2) -- (4, -2.2) node[midway, below, label] {Focal Length ($f$)};

    % Angle of View lines
    \draw[dashed, thin] (4, 1.25) -- (0,0) -- (-7.5,-2.34);
    \draw[dashed, thin] (4, -1.25) -- (0,0) -- (-7.5, 2.34);
    \draw (-1.5, 0.4) arc (160:200:1.5) node[midway, left, label] {AoV ($\theta$)};

\end{tikzpicture}
